goal: Resolve the AC-DEV-018 candidate ambiguity for agent.definition_catalog through independent bounded operational evidence from Goose and Freebuff, without policy tie-breaking or permanent executor selection.
scope: canonical operational definition and acceptance criteria for agent.definition_catalog
disposable local probes of Goose and Freebuff runtime catalog surfaces
separate source evidence from operational evidence
registry mapping reconciliation and durable operational receipts
rerun of AC-DEV-017 matching and AC-DEV-018 admission
bounded control-plane eligibility refresh and autonomous run-loop continuation
out_of_scope: ECC installation, source import, dependency addition, or adoption
executor-specific integration or Apex Core redesign
credential inspection, secret persistence, or production execution
treating UI labels, source symbols, documentation, or self-report as operational proof
architecture_constraints: agent.definition_catalog means discoverable native agent definitions with stable runtime identity
a catalog claim requires an operational runtime enumeration or stable named entry, not a UI label, source symbol, or documentation statement
source evidence and operational evidence remain separately classified
AC-DEV-018 admission remains fail-closed and its default no-tie-break policy is unchanged
Apex Control Plane retains admission, candidate selection, scheduling, and reconciliation ownership
Apex Core retains authority, verification, retry/rework, and semantic-success ownership
no ECC installation and no permanent executor selection
acceptance_criteria: Goose is independently probed in a disposable isolated profile; an operationally discoverable native agent-definition catalog with stable entries is required for PARTIAL or PROVEN
Freebuff is independently probed in a disposable isolated workspace; an operationally discoverable native agent-definition catalog with stable entries is required for PARTIAL or PROVEN
unrelated skills catalogs, parent model pickers, @agents labels, source symbols, and documentation are explicitly excluded from acceptance
each executor claim is classified PROVEN, PARTIAL, or NOT_PROVEN with direct operational evidence and source evidence kept separate
registry mappings change only where the new operational evidence justifies the claim
AC-DEV-017 matching and AC-DEV-018 admission are rerun with the reconciled registry and preserve BLOCKED_CAPABILITY or BLOCKED_AMBIGUITY as applicable
the admission decision records no dispatch, no runtime side effects, no permanent executor selection, and no SOURCE_ID_ASC tie-break unless independently justified by policy
eligibility is reconciled and the autonomous run loop continues within the bounded control-plane scope
validation: disposable Goose and Freebuff operational probe
registry JSON, backlog JSON, and Passport validation
AC-DEV-017 candidate plan and AC-DEV-018 admission determinism checks
focused Python tests, documentation validation, git diff --check, and protected CI gate
